summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Fast Track Group (NASDAQ: FTRK), a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, furnishing a press release reporting financial and operational results for the fiscal year ended February 28, 2026. It includes a letter to shareholders discussing strategic focus on celebrity agency business, operational highlights, and future outlook. No corporate transaction, special situation, or event triggering a special-purpose classification is present. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation filing. The press release is furnished, not filed, for Section 18 purposes. No deal terms, advisory roles, or structural changes are disclosed. This filing is an ordinary periodic report.
